root_motivation: Two failures observed 2026-09-05. First, brittleness: `summa lint` hard-errored with `did not find expected key at line 11 column 28` and reported nothing, because three human-authored files (references/cagan-*.md) carried unquoted `[[wikilinks]]` in frontmatter; one bad file silenced every health check for the whole vault, for however long those files sat there. Second, neglect: once the files were hand-fixed, lint's own numbers showed nothing consumes them — orphans 185, dangling 646, missing_index 1545, un_ingested 118. There is no loop in which anyone runs lint, so findings accumulate without a reader. /self-review already tends this laptop daily and journals to ~/brain/journal/; the wiki is simply absent from its checklist.
user_persona: UNSPECIFIED — no existing intent card to carry forward from; set by hand (intent-card-refresh.sh cannot source this from a PRD).

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a vault copy containing a file with unquoted `[[wikilink]]` frontmatter (the cagan shape), When `summa lint` runs, Then it reports that file as malformed with the parser error and still reports every other check's counts.
Given the live vault, When `summa lint --fix` runs, Then missing_index is 0, and a second immediate run changes nothing and still reports 0.

Given a dangling link whose target exists under a case-variant name, When `--fix` runs, Then the link is repaired; Given a link whose target exists nowhere, Then it survives verbatim and is reported truly-dangling.
Given a machine without summa on PATH, When the new /self-review block executes, Then it emits nothing and the review continues.
Given summa present, When the /self-review block executes, Then exactly one `summa:` line with counts lands in the day's journal.
Given `--json`, When it runs, Then output parses and carries counts plus per-finding arrays for malformed, dangling (split), orphans, and un-ingested.
Given this PRD's build on the live vault, When the backlog pass completes, Then the ship note records before/after counts and missing_index after is 0.
Given `--fix` with repairs performed, When it completes, Then a one-line summary states files touched, links repaired, and index entries added.
